prompts.axe: Use case: stylized-concept. Create production game sprite sheet for a NEW two-handed AXEMAN matching the two reference sheets EXACTLY in art style, camera, figure proportions, lighting and level of detail. Reference 1 is the game's existing swordsman, reference 2 its archer; neither is an edit target. Same detailed hand-painted pixel-textured pre-rendered isometric medieval RTS art, rich steel highlights, leather, cloth folds, subtle thin dark edge, realistic proportions. NOT cartoon, NOT vector, NOT polygonal flat fills, NOT thick black outlines. Character: steel helmet, cream tunic over chainmail, crimson shoulder cloth/team sash, brown boots and gloves, NO shield, NO sword. Holds a large single-headed battle axe on a long wooden haft with BOTH HANDS throughout. Slight elevated 3/4 camera, facing screen-right/down exactly like the refs. Genuine transparent background. EXACTLY 4 equal columns x 2 equal rows, total EIGHT separate full-body frames, wide 2:1 sheet. Top row FOUR distinct walking phases; bottom row FOUR heavy axe attack phases: ready, overhead two-hand windup, downward-forward heavy chop with clear followthrough, recovery. Exact same identity and physical scale in every frame. Each cell includes complete axe and feet, generous margins, no overlap across cells. Fixed feet ground anchor at 85% cell height, center horizontally. No floor/shadow/text/grid/watermark. This will be sliced into individual animation cells and displayed beside original infantry at about 45 px height; prioritize clear detailed game sprites rather than large concept illustration.
prompts.worker: Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent sprite sheet of a civilian WORKER for the exact medieval isometric RTS art family in both references. References only establish art style/camera/material detail/realistic proportions. Match fine hand-painted pixel-textured shading, thin subtle edges, cloth folds and leather detail. No vector/flat polygons/thick black outlines/cartoon. Same slightly elevated 3/4 camera, face screen-right/down like reference archer. Civilian man: simple tan working cap, rough beige linen tunic, crimson waist sash denoting team, brown trousers and leather boots, bare forearms; no armor, bow, quiver, sword, shield. EXACTLY 4 COLUMNS x 4 ROWS, SIXTEEN full-body separate frames on genuinely transparent square canvas, no grid/text/shadows/floor. Every equal cell has same scale and ground foot baseline 85% down, generous margins, equipment fully inside cell. Row1 FOUR different normal walking phases holding wooden handled short shovel at side. Row2 FOUR distinct work phases using shovel: ready, raise, digging strike toward ground, recover. Row3 FOUR distinct low-power self-defence phases using same shovel: ready, raise across torso, short two-handed shove/swing, recover. Row4 FOUR distinct walking/carrying phases with a bulky tied burlap resource sack held against front torso with both arms; shovel tucked behind shoulder. SAME identity/clothing/size across all 16. Clear professional game sprites readable at 45px display height and visually indistinguishable in rendering quality from old archer. Avoid exaggerated head, straw cone caricature, detached limbs, duplicate stationary poses or overlapping cells.
prompts.medic: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game animation sprite sheet for a MEDIC matching both reference images exactly in detailed hand-painted pixel-textured medieval isometric RTS art, camera and human proportions. NOT a new style. Thin subtle edges, volumetric shading, cream cloth folds, brown leather highlights. No vector, geometric flat fills, thick outlines, cartoon. Adult field medic: cream/ivory linen hood and robe with crimson team shoulder collar and belt sash, brown boots, small brown leather medical satchel marked with a small white medical cross, no weapons, no armor, no bow/quiver. Same slightly elevated three-quarter camera, facing screen-right/down as reference archer. EXACTLY FOUR equal columns and TWO equal rows, EIGHT separately sliceable full-body frames on genuine transparent wide 2:1 sheet. Top row FOUR distinct walk phases, satchel held in left hand. Bottom row FOUR distinct healing phases: pause and open satchel, take bandage, extend right arm with bandage toward patient ahead (patient NOT drawn), recover. SAME identity, body scale and costume every cell. Feet ground anchor fixed at 85% cell height, enough clear padding, no cut off equipment or overlap between cells. No floor, shadows, text, labels, magic particles, aura, grid or watermark. Medic must have the reference archer's realistic head/body ratio and fine cloth/leather detailing, legible beside original soldiers at about 45px height.
